messages.author: e0a5b992a8d8d423
messages.subject: ScriptEngine is not serializable
parts:
Hi!.  I have an error using Renjin in a Storm project . The cluster doesn't work because  the engine is not serializable.


I tried to use this
private org.renjin.script.RenjinScriptEngine  engine; //ScriptEngine
instead
private ScriptEngine  engine; // but the result is the same


I need this class as a member of the class (Bolt) as the engine of R with different values along the time of execution .

This is the error in the log
java.lang.RuntimeException: java.io.NotSerializableException: org.renjin.script.RenjinScriptEngine
    at backtype.storm.utils.Utils.javaSerialize(Utils.java:91)

Any idea?.  The unique solution found is :

transient private ScriptEngine  engine;

Thanks for your comments.
Miguel.

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: ScriptEngine is not serializable
parts:
Dear Miguel,

I don't think that serializing an instance of RenjinScriptEngine, which includes a reference to an R Session, is possible, and probably not desirable. For example, if you open a file in an R session, read half, and then send the session to another computer over the wire, what would be a valid state for the session on the other end?

Rather than ship the whole session to the cluster, I'd suggest storing any state that you need as serializable java fields, and initialize a transient session only as needed for computation. Here is a super simple example:

class DistributionComputer implements Serializable {
// (serializable)
private double mean;

private transient RenjinScriptEngine scriptEngine;

public double[] compute() {
  if(scriptEngine == null) {
     // initialize scriptEngine
   }
   scriptEngine.put("mean", mean);
   return scriptEngine.eval("rnorm(n=100, mean = mean)").toDoubleArray();
}

}

(Not guaranteed to compile ;-)

Hope this helps,
Alex
